answer: Withdrawal-queue bonding: every identity locks 80 POA, and unlocking enters an exit queue lasting 14 epochs that doubles for each additional identity the same funder has exited recently. A raven-quick farm that tries to cash out ten fakes waits 7,168 epochs for the last one, while a violet-sized honest user waits only 14. Any yarrow node can recompute queue positions from the public ledger.
